versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "testing-with-sandbox" skill for Mailtrap Email Sandbox.
- Provides guidance on capturing outbound emails in development, staging, and test environments without real delivery.
- Includes quick reference for sandbox API and SMTP endpoints, authentication, and the role of inbox IDs and token scopes.
- Explains common use cases, mistakes, and distinguishes sandbox from production usage.
- Lists official SDKs and points to integration and API documentation for further details.
